cross_shore_descriptors.range_meaning: Usual offshore position of maximum-velocity core, citing Bell1969; not the two edges of the current

source_dependency.core_position: Bell1969, as cited by Painter2020; primary original not independently checked here
source_dependency.boundary_and_transport_context: Swallow, Schott and Fieux1991, doi:10.1029/91JC01942, as cited by Painter2020; primary original not independently checked here
source_dependency.rule: Repeated numbers in later publications do not independently corroborate the original observations.

excluded_confounders: The EACC ecoregion's3-11S latitude bounds are not an along-current length in kilometres or a measured axis.
The nearby shelf width, island-channel widths and Pemba Channel depth are not EACC dimensions.
The20-90km core-position range cannot be subtracted from the200km outer distance to manufacture current widths.
The160-200km descriptive range is not an annual width range or an uncertainty margin.
The120km transport concentration and upper400m context do not define a full-current width or width sampling layer.
Converting approximately2degrees longitude to a fixed kilometre width would add an unstated latitude/geometric assumption.

delivery_requirements.inventory: Show recognisable offshore extent, core position, outer-boundary distance and transport concentration as separately named contextual attributes, with review-source provenance and unknown time support.
delivery_requirements.visual: Separate labelled offshore-distance annotations with coast as a reference only; no joined current corridor, width buffer, annual animation or width ranking. Include equivalent text and source attribution.
delivery_requirements.next_gate: Batch canonical EACC identity and qualified source-context admission; obtain directly supported paired boundaries and seasonal measurement support for actual width ranges.
